Name: (AT) P4 Bedding
Author: Padme4000
Description:
[color=#e69138][size=4][b]Description[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#ffffff]This mod includes 18 cute retextures of the vanilla bed for the players Single, Double and child bed.[/color]

[color=#ffffff]Includes a wavy looking bedding, neurodiversity infinity symbols, bee hive, mermaid and plaid/tartan inspired bedding.[/color]

To explain the Infinity symbol versions, they represent different parts of the Neurodiversity community:
[list]
[*]The Rainbow represents the infinite potential, diversity, and strengths in the whole of the Neurodiversity community.[/*]
[*]The Gold represents Autism (Au is the symbol used for the chemical element Gold and is often associated with Autism due to Autism starting with Au )[/*]
[*]The Orange represents ADHD Awareness[/*]
[/list]
As I am myself an Autistic I like having things in games where I can add just a little touch of representation.

Some of the versions available were inspired by my recent creations for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/storyofseasonsgrandbazaar/mods/115]Bedding Retextures at Story of Seasons: Grand Bazaar[/url] and the neurodiverse ones I made for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/masseffectlegendaryedition/mods/351]Pride Bedding for LE2 at Mass Effect Legendary Edition[/url] though this mod doesn't include any of the LGBTQA+ bedding from that mod I am looking into making them but due to the amount they will be a separate mod.

[color=#e69138][size=4][b]Installation Instructions[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Install SMAPI and Alternative Textures[/*]
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI[/*]
[/list]
[b][color=#e69138][size=4]Uninstall Instructions[/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*]remove the mod folder from Stardew Valley/Mods[/*]
[/list]
[color=#e69138][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#ffffff]This mod requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] to work.[/color]

[color=#e69138][size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#ffffff]Big thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/246708344]orochifrogu[/url] for this video tutorial  [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1mXtGbatIYw]EASY: How to MAKE a MOD for Stardew Valley (using Alternative Textures!)[/url] and for inspiring me to finally try my hand at retexturing the vanilla bedding.[/color]
I used the Plaid/Tartan smart materials for Substance that I bought from this creator:  [url=https://www.artstation.com/mahsanaghdi3/store]ArtStation - mahsa naghdi[/url]
To nexus and everyone else involved in creating this event. I've been playing Stardew since it released and always wanted to create something for it, but never tried until now. Thank you for the inspiration to try.
